This is a **very common GoHighLevel confusion**, and the key thing to understand is this:

👉 **GHL does NOT send booking notifications to your calendar by default**  
👉 **There is no “email sender” you whitelist to make it appear on your calendar**

Instead, you must either **sync the calendar correctly** or **add an internal notification workflow**.

I’ll break this down cleanly so you know exactly what’s happening and how to fix it.

---

## First: Why This Is Happening (Important)

When someone books via your **GHL calendar link**:

- ✅ The **contact** gets a confirmation email
- ❌ **You do NOT automatically get**:
  - A calendar invite
  - A pop-up
  - A booking email
  - A calendar reminder

Unless you explicitly configure it.

So there is **no mystery email address** being blocked by Google or Outlook.

---

## Option 1 (BEST PRACTICE): Sync GHL → Your Google Calendar

This is what makes bookings **actually land on your calendar**.

### Step-by-Step

1. Go to **Settings → Profile**
2. Scroll to **Calendar Configuration**
3. Click **Connect Google Account**
4. Select the Google account you want bookings to appear on
5. Make sure:
   - ✅ Correct Google calendar is selected
   - ✅ Sync is ON

Now when someone books:
- The appointment **appears on your Google Calendar**
- You get your **normal Google notifications**
- No email permissions required

### Test it
- Book a test call
- Refresh Google Calendar
- You should see the event instantly

If you do not, the calendar is not properly connected.

---

## Option 2: Add an Internal Booking Notification (Highly Recommended)

This is separate from the calendar and ensures you **never miss a booking**.

### Create a Simple Workflow

Go to **Automation → Workflows**

**Trigger**
- Appointment Status = **Booked**
- Select your calendar

**Action**
- Send Email → **To User (You)**

### Example Internal Notification Email

Subject:
```
📅 New Call Booked: {{contact.first_name}}
```

Body:
```
A new call has been booked.

Name: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
Time: {{appointment.start_time}}
Calendar: {{appointment.calendar_name}}

Meeting Link:
{{appointment.meeting_location}}
```

Now:
- You get an email every time someone books
- You’re notified even if your calendar sync glitches

---

## Option 3: Add SMS or App Notification (Power User Move)

You can also:
- Send yourself an SMS
- Use GHL mobile app push notifications

This is clutch if you book high-ticket calls.

---

## Important Clarification About “What Email Is It Coming From?”

To be very clear:

- ❌ There is NO booking email sent to you by default
- ❌ There is NO sender email to whitelist
- ✅ The event only appears if:
  - Calendar sync is connected **OR**
  - You create a workflow notification

If someone told you “check spam” or “whitelist GHL” — that advice is incorrect in this case.

---

## My Recommendation for You (Luxora-Level Setup)

Do **ALL THREE**:
1. Sync Google Calendar
2. Internal email notification workflow
3. Optional SMS alert

That gives you:
- Calendar visibility
- Immediate awareness
- Backup protection

---

- Walk you through **why your Google Calendar sync might not be firing**
- Audit your calendar + workflow setup
- Help you build a **no-show-proof booking system**

Just tell me which one you want.

Perfect question. This is **exactly** what GoHighLevel (GHL) is good at once it’s set up correctly. I’ll walk you through this **step-by-step**, clean and simple, no fluff.

I’ll assume:
- You’re using **GoHighLevel**
- You want **automatic email reminders**
- You want your **Zoom / Google Meet / custom meeting link** included automatically
- You want this to feel professional and hands-off

---

## PART 1: Create the Calendar in GoHighLevel

### 1. Go to Calendars
In GHL:
- Settings → **Calendars**
- Click **+ Create Calendar**

### 2. Calendar Settings
Fill in:

- **Calendar Name:**  
  Example: `Luxora Discovery Call`

- **Calendar Type:**  
  Choose **Round Robin** (if multiple team members)  
  or **Single User** (just you)

- **Assign User:**  
  Select yourself (or team)

- **Meeting Location**
  Choose **Custom**
  Paste your meeting link here:
  - Zoom link  
  - Google Meet link  
  - Riverside link  
  - Whatever you use  

This is IMPORTANT because GHL can dynamically insert this into reminders.

Example:
```
Zoom Link: https://zoom.us/j/XXXX
```

Save.

---

## PART 2: Connect Your Email + SMS (Critical)

Before reminders work correctly, make sure:

### Email
- Settings → **Email Services**
- Connect:
  - Google Workspace or
  - Mailgun (recommended if you’re scaling)

### SMS (Optional but powerful)
- Settings → **Phone Numbers**
- Make sure a number is assigned

If email isn’t connected, reminders will NOT send.

---

## PART 3: Create the Reminder Workflow (This Is the Magic)

GHL does **not** auto-send reminders unless you tell it to.

### 1. Go to Automation → Workflows
Click **+ Create Workflow**

### 2. Choose Trigger
Select:
- **Appointment Status**
- Status: **Booked**
- Calendar: Select your new calendar

This tells GHL: *when someone books, start automation*

---

## PART 4: Add Email Reminder With Meeting Link

### Email #1 – Confirmation (Immediately)

Add Action:
- **Send Email**

Example email copy:
```
Subject: Your Call Is Confirmed ✅

Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Your call is booked!

📅 Date & Time:
{{appointment.start_time}}

🔗 Join the call here:
{{appointment.meeting_location}}

If anything comes up, you can reschedule here:
{{appointment.reschedule_link}}

Looking forward to connecting,
Bethany
```

IMPORTANT merge fields:
- `{{appointment.meeting_location}}` ← this pulls your Zoom/Meet link automatically
- `{{appointment.start_time}}`

---

### Email #2 – 24 Hours Before

Add:
- **Wait → 1 Day Before Appointment**
- **Send Email**

Example:
```
Subject: Reminder: Your Call Tomorrow

Just a quick reminder about your call tomorrow.

🔗 Meeting Link:
{{appointment.meeting_location}}

Talk soon,
Bethany
```

---

### Email #3 – 1 Hour Before (Optional but powerful)

Add:
- **Wait → 1 Hour Before Appointment**
- **Send Email**

Short and sweet.

---

## PART 5: (Optional but HIGHLY Recommended) SMS Reminder

Add action:
- **Send SMS**

Example:
```
Hi {{contact.first_name}}, this is a reminder for your call starting soon.

Join here:
{{appointment.meeting_location}}

– Bethany
```

This dramatically reduces no-shows.

---

## PART 6: Test Everything (Do NOT Skip)

1. Book a test appointment using the calendar link
2. Confirm:
   - Confirmation email arrives
   - Meeting link shows correctly
   - Reminder timing works

If the meeting link doesn’t show:
- Go back to **Calendar → Meeting Location**
- Make sure the link is entered there, not just in the email

---

## Pro Tips (Luxora-Level Polish)

- Use **calendar-specific workflows** so each offer has its own messaging
- Add a **pre-call prep email** (what to expect, who it’s for, who it’s not)
- Add a **no-show workflow** that auto-follows up if they don’t attend
- Add a **post-call workflow** with next steps + recap

Here’s a **clean, step-by-step way to set this up in GoHighLevel (GHL)** so you get **email reminders** and your **meeting link is automatically included** for every booking.

I’ll break this into **3 short sections** so you can follow it once and be done.

---

## 1️⃣ Create or Connect Your Calendar in GHL

**Path:**
Settings → Calendars → **Connections**

### Option A: Connect Google Calendar (recommended)
1. Click **Connect**
2. Sign into your Google account
3. Choose the calendar you want GHL to write to
4. Save

This prevents double booking and keeps everything synced.

---

## 2️⃣ Set Up the Booking Calendar (Availability + Meeting Link)

**Path:**
Settings → Calendars → **Calendar Settings** → Create New (or edit existing)

### Key Settings to Configure

**Calendar Type**
- Choose **Round Robin** (team) or **Personal**

**Availability**
- Set your working days and time blocks
- Add buffer times if needed

**Meeting Location (THIS IS IMPORTANT)**
- Choose **Custom**
- Paste your meeting link:
  - Zoom
  - Google Meet
  - Riverside
  - Calendly (if routing)
- Example:
  ```
  Zoom Meeting Link:
  https://zoom.us/j/XXXXXXXX
  ```

GHL will automatically insert this link into confirmations and reminders.

---

## 3️⃣ Turn On Email (and SMS) Reminders Automatically

This is controlled by **Workflows**, not the calendar itself.

### Create the Reminder Workflow

**Path:**
Automation → Workflows → **Create Workflow**

**Trigger**
- Appointment Status = **Booked**
- Select your specific calendar

---

### Add These Actions (Best Practice)

**Action 1: Confirmation Email (Immediately)**
- Action: **Send Email**
- Include dynamic fields:
  - {{appointment.start_time}}
  - {{appointment.location}} ← this pulls your meeting link automatically
  - {{contact.first_name}}

**Action 2: Reminder Email (24 hours before)**
- Action: **Wait**
  - 1 day before appointment
- Action: **Send Email**

**Action 3: Reminder Email (1 hour before)**
- Action: **Wait**
  - 1 hour before appointment
- Action: **Send Email**

Optional but powerful:
- Add SMS reminders using the same structure

---

## 4️⃣ What to Put in the Email (Simple Template)

**Subject:**
Your Call Is Booked ✔

**Body:**
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Your call is confirmed for  
{{appointment.start_time}}

Join here at the time of the call:  
{{appointment.location}}

If you need to reschedule, please use the link in your confirmation email.

Looking forward to connecting,  
Bethany

---

## 5️⃣ Final Test (Do NOT Skip This)
1. Book a test appointment
2. Confirm:
   - Calendar blocks correctly
   - Confirmation email arrives
   - Meeting link is included
   - Reminder emails fire

---

### Pro Tip (Luxora-Level Polish)
Add:
- A **pre-call questionnaire**
- A **calendar no-show prevention SMS**
- A **post-call follow-up workflow**

- Build the exact **email copy**

Perfect. I’ll walk you through this **exactly as you would click it in GoHighLevel**, step by step, so you can build it once and never think about it again.

This will do **two things**:
1. Email you **immediately** when someone books  
2. Email you **reminders** before the call so nothing slips

No tech fluff. Just the clicks.

---

# GOAL  
When someone books your GHL calendar:
- ✅ You get an instant “New Booking” email  
- ✅ You get reminder emails (24 hours + 1 hour before)

---

## STEP 1: Create the Workflow

1. Go to **Automation**
2. Click **Workflows**
3. Click **+ Create Workflow**
4. Choose **Start from Scratch**
5. Name it:
   ```
   INTERNAL – Booking Notifications & Reminders
   ```
6. Click **Create**

---

## STEP 2: Set the Trigger (This Is Critical)

1. Click **+ Add Trigger**
2. Select **Appointment Status**
3. Configure:
   - **Status:** Booked
   - **Calendar:** Select the exact calendar they are booking from
4. Save Trigger

This tells GHL:
> “Every time someone books THIS calendar, run this workflow.”

---

## STEP 3: Immediate Email Notification to YOU

1. Click **+ Add Action**
2. Choose **Send Email**

### Email Settings
- **Send To:** User  
- **User:** Select **your name**  
  (NOT Contact — this is the most common mistake)

### Email Content (Copy/Paste Friendly)

**Subject:**
```
📅 New Call Booked – {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
```

**Body:**
```
You have a new call booked.

Client: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
Email: {{contact.email}}
Phone: {{contact.phone}}

Date & Time:
{{appointment.start_time}}

Calendar:
{{appointment.calendar_name}}

Meeting Link:
{{appointment.meeting_location}}
```

3. Save Action

✅ At this point, you’ll get an email every time someone books.

---

## STEP 4: Add 24-Hour Reminder Email (To You)

1. Click **+ Add Action**
2. Choose **Wait**
3. Set:
   - **Wait until:** 1 day before appointment
4. Save

### Add Email Action After the Wait

- **Send To:** User  
- **User:** You

**Subject:**
```
⏰ Reminder: Call Tomorrow – {{contact.first_name}}
```

**Body:**
```
Reminder that you have a call scheduled for tomorrow.

Client: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
Time:
{{appointment.start_time}}

Join Link:
{{appointment.meeting_location}}
```

Save.

---

## STEP 5: Add 1-Hour Reminder Email (To You)

Repeat the same pattern:

1. **Add Action → Wait**
   - Wait until **1 hour before appointment**
2. **Add Action → Send Email**
   - Send To: User
   - User: You

**Subject:**
```
🚨 Call Starting Soon – {{contact.first_name}}
```

**Body:**
```
Your call starts in about 1 hour.

Client: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
Time:
{{appointment.start_time}}

Meeting Link:
{{appointment.meeting_location}}
```

Save.

---

## STEP 6: Publish the Workflow (Don’t Forget This)

Top right corner:
- Toggle **Draft → Publish**

If it’s not published, nothing will fire.

---

## STEP 7: Test It (Mandatory)

1. Open your GHL calendar booking link
2. Book a test appointment using a personal email
3. Confirm:
   - You get the **instant booking email**
   - You see the reminder emails scheduled
   - Meeting link appears correctly

If you don’t get the email:
- Double-check **Send To = User**
- Make sure you selected the **correct calendar**
- Confirm your email is connected under **Settings → Profile**

---

## OPTIONAL BUT POWERFUL UPGRADES

### Add SMS Reminder to Yourself
Great if you’re mobile.

```
🚨 New call booked with {{contact.first_name}} at {{appointment.start_time}}
```

### Add Slack or App Notification
If you live inside Slack or the GHL app.

---

## Common Mistakes (Avoid These)

- ❌ Sending to Contact instead of User
- ❌ Not selecting the correct calendar
- ❌ Forgetting to publish
- ❌ Assuming GHL auto-notifies you (it does not)

---

## Final Recommendation for You

For a founder booking high-value calls:
- Workflow notifications = **non-negotiable**
- Calendar sync = backup
- SMS reminder = elite setup

If you want, next I can:
- Send you **screenshots-style click map**
- Help you clone this for **multiple calendars**
- Add **no-show protection logic**
